title: Everyday Vowing: Renunciation and Repentance
speaker: Seiu Hannah Sullivan
summary: Seiu Hannah Sullivan's main teaching emphasizes the importance of cultivating compassion and kindness in the face of suffering, whether it comes from within or from the world around us. By prioritizing our own well-being and practicing mindfulness, we can better navigate life's challenges and find ways to live with greater ease and understanding. This involves embracing our humanity and imperfections, rather than trying to achieve perfection, and instead focusing on working with what we have to recover our original self through devotion to kindness and support of others.
